item.title: Report Junk & Phishing Emails in Outlook
item.description: Use the Report Message button on the Outlook ribbon to flag junk or phishing emails. This helps Microsoft block malicious URLs across LeavePlus inboxes.

item.title: Reminder: Keep Walkways Clear

item.description: Aim for at least 30 minutes of sunlight daily for vitamin D. In winter, consider a supplement or food sources of this essential nutrient.
